items.title: When sections over affines are countable, derived quasi-coherent objects are homotopy colimits of perfect objects exactly when their cohomology sheaves have countable section sets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter perfect.tex (Derived Categories of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: 38 行、两个方向：①(1)⇒(2)：hocolim 与上同调层交换（derived 引理）+ perfect 局部是有限自由有限复形 ⇒ 各 H^i(K) 在仿射开上截面可数；②(2)⇒(1)：取 K-单射代表与 perfect 生成元 E 的 K-单射代表，用 Ddga 定理（本线 L22125）的等价 F 把 K 变成 dg 模 M = Hom(I,K)，H^i(A)=Ext(E,E)、H^i(M)=Ext(E,K)；F 与拟逆同 hocolim 交换 ⇒ 只需把 M 写成 D(A,d) 紧对象的 hocolim；③dga 可数引理把这一步归到 Ext 群可数，恰由 countable-cohomology 引理（本线 L22128）给出。承重的传递与归约在 span 内；4 处引用（2 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-countable (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 8556-8568

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the direction from the homotopy colimit of perfects to countable cohomology via commutation of hocolim with cohomology sheaves, and the converse transporting the object through the dga equivalence to a dg module, reducing to writing the module as a homotopy colimit of compact objects via the countable dga lemma and the countability of the Ext groups (source lines 8570-8607)
